description: Dependency bump PRs into dev (never main: merging main deploys). One click to merge; CI on the PR is the gate.

packageRules.description: Weekly: every non-major Python package in one PR.
Weekly: GitHub Actions in one PR (tests/unit/scripts/test_workflows.py keeps the Node 24 / pinned-runner rules).
Weekly: base and service images in one PR.
ruff in pyproject and in .pre-commit-config.yaml move together.
uv: the Dockerfile image and the pre-commit hook move together.
Downloaders: site extractors break and get fixed between releases, so daily, no wait, nightlies allowed (yt-dlp is pinned to nightlies on purpose, pyproject.toml).
Postgres/Redis majors change the on-disk format of prod data (dump/restore): never as a bump PR.
Python stays on 3.15 (prod image, mypy python_version, .python-version) until moved on purpose.
